_comment: Transform control for row759_hidden_quality_cell.json. It must exit 1 with its mutant ESCAPED. The mutation is a PURE PARENTHESISATION of an argument in the very block row 759 edits: the code parses, imports and behaves identically, so the band must not notice it. A CAUGHT here would mean the main battery's CAUGHTs are parse or import breaks rather than behaviour, and every CAUGHT in it would be worthless.
subject: transform control -- a behaviour-preserving rewrite inside the row 759 admission block is invisible to the row 759 band

mutants.label: TC1 pure parenthesisation of a _note_admission_drop argument (no behaviour change)
